opening.argument: The StrongBlock presentation frames participation as passive DeFi income, requiring an investment of ten STRONG to create a node and describing an approximately 300 percent annualized interest return. Viewers are instructed to obtain STRONG through an exchange, transfer it to MetaMask, create the node, and pay recurring maintenance fees, with forfeiture for missed payments and no ability to unstake or sell the investment. The displayed amount is presented as continuing to grow. The speaker acknowledges that the yield may not be sustainable and that nothing is set in stone. The records do not establish whether the service delivered these returns or whether any loss occurred.
